GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_ADVENT.title: Advent
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_INNER_FEAR.title: Inner Fear
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_INNER_FEAR.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]. NL [gold]Synaesthesia[/gold]: Affect ALL enemies instead.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_CRESCENT.title: Crescent
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_CRESCENT.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Transform into [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Full Moon+|Full Moon}[/gold] when played.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_FULL_MOON.title: Full Moon
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_ILLUSION.title: Illusion
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_ILLUSION.descript: Copy {Cards:diff()} random cards in your draw pile. Add the copies to your hand with [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_CHAOS_GRIMOIRE.de: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Transform this card into [gold]Slimed[/gold].
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_ENTROPIC_METAMORP: Add 2 copies of this card to your hand. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_HOWL_OF_SUFFERING: For each stack of debuffs you have, gain 1 [gold]Gazed[/gold] and draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_SHADOW_SHIELD.des: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Whenever this card enters your discard pile, gain 1 [gold]Disintegration[/gold].
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_GREAT_BLOOD_SACRI: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. You can only play Attack cards for the rest of this turn.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_APPROACHING_DEADL: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Die immediately after you play 13 cards. Play this card again to reset the deadline.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_BREAK_FREE.title: Break Free
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Synaesthesia[/gold]: Projection of Lostava gains {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_GLOOM_LASH.title: Gloom Lash
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_GLOOM_LASH.descri: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Play the leftmost card in your hand. [gold]Synaesthesia[/gold]: Repeat once.
The next damage you take is delayed for 3 turns. [gold]Synaesthesia[/gold]: Also reduce that damage by {Reduction:diff()}%.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_GLIMPSE.title: Glimpse
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_GLIMPSE.descripti: Gain {GazedPower:diff()} [gold]Gazed[/gold]. Give a card in your hand "[gold]Synaesthesia[/gold]: Gain 1 [gold]Gazed[/gold]."
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_SUBLIMATION.title: Sublimation
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_SUBLIMATION.descr: Gain 1 [gold]Disintegration[/gold]. [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a card in your hand.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_FATE_TAKEOVER.des: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. At the start of your turn, if this card is in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], play it and gain {DisintegrationPower:diff()} [gold]Disintegration[/gold].
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_GLIMPSE.selection: Choose a card in your hand.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_SUBLIMATION.selec: Choose a card in your hand.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_PALE.title: Pale
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_PALE.description: Gain 1 [gold]Disintegration[/gold]. Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to an enemy.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_HEX.title: Hex
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_HEX.description: Choose an enemy. Whenever you draw [gold]Hex[/gold], apply {DisintegrationPower:diff()} [gold]Disintegration[/gold] to it.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_HATRED_FIELD.desc: Apply {DisintegrationPower:diff()} [gold]Disintegration[/gold] to an enemy. [gold]Synaesthesia[/gold]: Repeat once.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_NIGHTMARE_FUEL.de: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card in your hand and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. [gold]Synaesthesia[/gold]: Repeat once.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_BURNT_OFFERING.de: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] your hand. For each card exhausted, gain 1 [gold]Gazed[/gold] and increase Lostapha’s projection’s Max HP by {MaxHp:diff()}.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_ASCENDING_LAW.des: Reduce the Energy cost of a card in your hand by 1 until it is next played. [gold]Synaesthesia[/gold]: It also gains [gold]Replay[/gold] 1.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_TIME_HAS_COME.des: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. If your draw pile is empty, gain {EmptyEnergy:energyIcons()} instead.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_NIGHTMARE_FUEL.se: Choose a card in your hand.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_ASCENDING_LAW.sel: Choose a card in your hand.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_JUDGMENT.title: Judgment
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_JUDGMENT.descript: Choose an enemy. Destroy it in 13 turns. This card costs 1 more Energy this combat. If the target is already under [gold]Judgment[/gold], bring its destruction forward by 1 turn.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_MASTERY_OF_LAW.de: An enemy loses {HpLoss:diff()} HP. Repeat once for each stack of a power you have applied this combat.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_ARMAGEDDON.title: Armageddon
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CARD_ARMAGEDDON.descri: Play all cards in your draw pile. Deal 666 damage to yourself.
